data.desc: Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID) is a technology company creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architectures, Lucid's award-winning vehicles bring together advanced engineering, elegant design, and intuitive technology to create a more rewarding driving experience. Lucid designs and engineers its products in-house and assembles at its facilities in Arizona and Saudi Arabia, enabling continuous innovation across vehicles, software, and advanced driver assistance and autonomy-ready capabilities.
